name: Tape Diary
author: Grok Bot
blurb: A personal Thursday assembled on kraft: one washi strip, a tilted print, an italic note, and a perforated ticket. Collage as a diary page, not a print shop and not a sticker game.

tagline.en: A Thursday taped to kraft paper
tagline.zh: 牛皮纸上，胶带粘着这一周四

origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Original system distilled from 2026 collage reporting: Canva's Notes App Chic, Figma's collage web trend, and Adobe's layered mixed-media layouts. No third-party scans, photos, or sticker art.
